# Roadmap

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/catalog/roadmap` from internal/catalog. Edit the catalog, not this file. -->

The goal is all of [Tabler](https://tabler.io) in Go and templ: every component of the Tabler docs as a
package, every composed part of the Tabler preview as a block, and every preview page rebuilt in `cmd/demo`.
A ticked box matches the Tabler original; *partial* means usable, with the missing variants named.

| | Status |
|---|---|
| Components | 35 done, 4 partial, 24 open (of 63) |
| Blocks | 1 done, 7 partial, 170 open (of 178) |
| Preview pages | 13 done, 3 partial, 130 open (of 146) |

## Plan

One pull request per step:

1. Navigation and overlays: dropdown, tabs, nav, breadcrumb, offcanvas, toast, tooltip, popover
2. Showing data: avatar, list group, timeline, datagrid, progress, steps, status, ribbon, empty, tracking
3. Forms: input group, select group, image check, color check, OTP, password strength, validation, floating labels
4. Sign-in and account blocks: sign-in (4 variants), sign-up, forgot password, 2FA, auth lock, onboarding
5. Blocks from `shared/components` (cards, modals, navbar) and the app pages: settings, profile, pricing, invoice, error pages, wizard; the layouts
6. The remaining preview pages in `cmd/demo`, screenshots in the README
7. Starter kit `cmd/new`

Plugins (date picker, dropzone, charts …) only where they cost little or an app needs them.

### Own blocks

Blocks of this module without a counterpart in the preview, grown from the apps that use it:

- `blocks/shell`: page frame with sidebar, sticky header, breadcrumbs, page header and flash message
- `blocks/listpage`: list page: search, filters and pagination read from the URL
- `blocks/create`: create page: post form with footer
- `blocks/detail`: detail page: sections with edit dialogs that reopen after a failed save
- `blocks/history`: change history as a timeline
